_doc: Waking up from a nap on a bench in the open (BenchNap, world/nap_gags.gd). If it rained while you slept you wake up soaked; otherwise `chance` of the time one of the other gags happens, weighted, never the same one twice in a row. {name} is the villager caught staring, {paper} the local paper. A layout can override any key with its own "naps" block (a city's paper, its own odds).

lines: You wake up under yesterday's {paper}. The wind takes it back.
Somebody tucked you in with the {paper}. The sports pages leave first.
You slept under the {paper}'s classifieds. One of them was for a mattress. The wind takes that one too.
Somebody left a wet umbrella open beside the bench to dry. It dried on you.
An umbrella stands open next to you, dripping. Its owner has very dry feet somewhere.
A stranger's umbrella spent the night drying over your left side. Your left side did not dry.
{name} was standing over you, staring, and has just remembered somewhere else to be.
You open your eyes. {name} is right there, watching you, and is suddenly very interested in the sky.
{name} was waiting for you to wake up. Or wasn't, and is leaving now, briskly.
It rained while you slept. You are mostly puddle now.
You slept through the rain. Your shoes didn't.
It rained in the night. The bench stayed dry underneath you. Only underneath you.
